metric_notes.answer_accuracy_pct: Calculated only from manually annotated answers; null means none are annotated.
metric_notes.unsupported_claim_rate_pct: Calculated only from manually annotated answers; this is a human-reviewed proxy, not an automatic hallucination detector.
metric_notes.source_selection_accuracy_pct: Compared with each case's expected_source label.
metric_notes.web_fallback_precision_pct: Of answers sent to web search, the fraction whose expected source was web search.
metric_notes.web_fallback_recall_pct: Of cases labeled for web search, the fraction actually sent to web search.
metric_notes.mean_latency_ms: Mean elapsed time for completed system calls in this run; excludes benchmark setup and manual review.
